01-recallcheck.png: RecallCheck: check a food package or household product against US recall records by barcode, photo or name.
02-barcode.png: A barcode read from a saved photo matches five FDA recall reports. The newest shows the lots and dates to compare.
03-photo.png: Photo search runs on the phone. This kettle has no close look-alike, so the page lists the five nearest recalls.
04-label.png: The label reader finds XY-15302, a model number a glue gun recall names, although the image match found nothing close.
05-measured.png: Held-out CPSC photos: right recall first 54% (47% on phone-like copies); reading the label lifts first place from 27% to 36%.
